title: Create Slice & Dice: All The Tools
description: Datapack that allows the Mechanical Slicer to hold pickaxes, shovels, and hoes
body: Create Slice & Dice: All The Tools is a simple datapack that gives the Mechanical Slicer added by [Create Slice & Dice](https://modrinth.com/mod/slice-and-dice) the ability to hold (and use if there's a recipe for it) pickaxes, shovels, and axes.
